I see my children are in good hands. Triller Morrell. Is that you? Yes. Did you come to take them away? No. I'm a fugitive, and I have work to do elsewhere. They're safer with you as they grow. I stayed close to make sure that you would find the sanctuary... and to kill the bears in the valley. I believe this is the last bear. ♪♪♪ These children are a gift. Take great care of them as they grow. May I have your hand? What is... What is this? At the sanctuary beside the waterfall, there was a small cave. Climb in it. There you will find a box. I have given you the key to open that box. Speak to Paris. Tell her that the contents of the box are for my children. Open the box when they are 12 summers old, old enough to understand what is inside. What is inside? Knowledge. Knowledge that will begin a new world. Better even than the world of our ancestors. Someday... we will be together. ♪♪♪♪ Name them Haniwa and Kofun. That way I will know them when they come to me. And we'll know they come to you? The answers are all in the box. Wait. Children, morel. Children, morel. Children, morel. Children, morel. I just heard Baba Voss calling the witch's name. Does this not bother you? Is there no law in this place? We are far away from the law here. Baba Voss is in charge now.  I would dare not offend him. Baba Voss is not the law. God is the law. Perhaps we are far away from God here, too. It was Baba Voss and it was Paris who condemned my mother, your own sister, to the bonfire. For what? Because she questioned the wisdom of letting a man like him, a stranger who would not speak of his past, to be in charge of the village? They burned her because they feared she spoke the truth. God doesn't lose sight of those things. And even if he did, I never will. Where have you been? Baba Voss. What happened? Only the truth. Sit down, my love. Why?
